name: The Missing Diplomat

angles.text: The kidnapped diplomat's abduction touches Stormwind's high-level security and reaches of conspirators across Alliance territories.
As a rogue, you can draw on covert skills to unravel secret dockets, find retired contacts, and question suspects discreetly in crowded taverns.

faq.answer: Mikhail was a former associate of Elling Trias who left Stormwind several years ago to retire in Menethil Harbor. He now works there as a bartender, and Trias points you to him as a trustworthy contact who can help find Slim.
Slim is a figure in Menethil Harbor believed to know something about the kidnapped diplomat. Mikhail can help you find Slim and learn what they know.
faq.q: Who is Slim and why are they looking for him?

faq.answer: The kidnapped diplomat's identity remains uncertain, even to the investigators. The intercepted docket confirms the abduction but leaves out the diplomat's identity and the conspirators' plans after the capture.

The trail leads to Menethil Harbor because Elling Trias's retired contact Mikhail tends bar there. The harbor is a port town on the coast of the Wetlands, and leads about the abduction pass through it.
faq.q: Why does the trail lead to Menethil Harbor?

faq.answer: The intercepted docket confirms the diplomat's abduction but leaves out where the captive was taken and what the abductors intend to do next.
faq.q: What does the docket reveal about the plot?

faq.answer: Elling Trias directs the investigation from Stormwind. He sends you to Mikhail, his old associate, who promised to help on Trias's word alone and without drawing public attention.
faq.q: What is Trias's involvement in this mission?

sections.body: You have a docket that confirms a diplomat was taken from Stormwind. It names neither the diplomat nor the conspirators' destination. So the trail leads beyond Stormwind's gates to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, where you can search among the harbor crowds and their secret dealings.
sections.title: A Trail to the Wetlands

sections.body:
Mikhail, a former associate of Elling Trias, retired from Stormwind several years ago and now tends the tavern in Menethil. You seek him to find Slim, who may know where the captive was taken or who arranged the abduction.

In the crowded tavern, discretion matters. Mention Trias's name, and Mikhail urges immediate silence before the conspirators notice your inquiry.
sections.title: Discreet Contacts in Menethil

summary: You follow the trail of a kidnapped Stormwind diplomat to Menethil Harbor. An intercepted docket confirms the abduction but leaves the diplomat's identity and the conspirators' destination unknown.
